summary: Stepstone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 9,773,649 shares for $253.4 million under its continuous private offering, as well as Q1 2026 NAV of $25.92/share and net investment income of $0.57/share. The filing is a routine periodic update on ongoing capital raising and financial results, not a special situation event. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The Form 8-K is strictly informational regarding unregistered equity sales and quarterly performance metrics.
